[[Lewisburg Station]] |terminal =[[Welch Station terminal entries|Welch Station information]] |cell name =POITrainStationWelchExt |formid ={{ID|0026462c}} |crafting = {{Crafting stations FO76 |armor =yes |cooking =yes }} |keywords =* {{Location keyword FO76|EMSIgnoredLocation}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeFastTravelDestination}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocThemeWorkingClass}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocRegionMTR}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocLootScalePOI}} |edid =SubMTRWelchTrainStationLocation }} '''Welch Station''' is a [[Fallout 76 locations|location]] in the [[Ash Heap]] region of [[Appalachia]]. The station takes the unique form of a small cabin overlooking the town. [[Dylan Rhodes]], a former miner, lives here. ==Background== Situated on the Red Line and within [[Welch]] city limits, the facility consists of a track-side platform and station building. The location provided ancillary services such as a staffed ticket sales counter and automated ticket machines before the [[Great War]]. At some point, it was appropriated by the [[Responders]] and set up as a hub for operations and trade via [[Vendor bot Responder|vendor bot]]. ==Layout== The station is situated on the northeastern corner of town, next to the stairs heading south from [[Mount Blair]] and across [[Fallout 76 roadways|State Route 83]]. Situated on an elevated ridge, the train station provides an enhanced view of the town's layout and potential threats. It is situated between [[Lewisburg Station]] to the east and [[Charleston Station]] to the north, on the Red Line. Welch Station has a unique layout when compared to other regional train stations, set inside a smaller wooden building. There is an [[Armor workbench (Fallout 76)|armor workbench]], [[ammunition vending machine]] and a [[Cooking station (Fallout 76)|cooking station]] on the building's exterior. A [[Vendor bot Responder|Responder vendor bot]] operates the trading post inside behind a counter. The interior also has a [[medical supplies vending machine]], [[punch card machine]], and a map flanking the western entryway, opposite a terminal and [[My stash box|stash box]]. On the town-side of the platform, there is a [[legendary exchange machine]] near the doorway. Dylan Rhodes will walk back and forth across the platform and make comments to the [[Vault Dweller (Fallout 76)|Vault Dwellers]]. [[The Ghoul]] can sometimes be found here when visiting the station. ==Notes== As of the ''[[Locked & Loaded]]'' update, a [[punch card machine]] was added to all [[Fallout 76 railways#Train_stations|train stations]]. ==Appearances== Welch Station appears only {{In|FO76}}. ==Gallery== FO76 191020 Welch ham radio.png|Ham radio set up at the station FO76 Welch Station tracks.png FO76 Welch Station legendex machine 1.png FO76 Welch Station legendex machine 2.png FO76 Welch Station counter 2.png FO76 Welch Station counter.png FO76 Welch Station external 1.png FO76 Welch Station external 2.png|Looking east towards [[Lewisburg Station]] FO76 Welch Station external 3.png FO76 Welch Station map.png ;''Post-Locked & Loaded'' FO76 Train station int 13.png FO76 Train station int 12.png FO76_Train_station_perk_3.png 76 2105 Welch Station Nuka machine.jpg {{Navbox locations FO76}} [[Category:Fallout 76 locations]] [[Category:Ash Heap locations]] [[Category:Responder locations]] [[Category:Fallout 76 railway locations]] [[ru:Станция Уэлч]] [[zh:威爾契站]] [[uk:Станція Велч]]
